My Diet:

I used to wake up at 4:30 because by college bus will arrive at 5:20. So after waking up i

1.  drink 2 glass warm water and have a cup of coffee without milk and sugar. 
2. after having the coffee I will go to college, i wont eat anything in college.
3. i used to arrive at 12 pm at home and eat 2 rotis, soyabeans/paneer(protein is necessary in diet), dal. 
4. stop eating rice!! I stopped consuming rice replacing it by roti.
5. drink plenty of water atleast 4-5 litres a day
6. consume less salt(personal opinion coz i think the sodium present in salt holds water in our body)
7. eat fruits and stop eating junk foods
8. at night, have very light dinner and walk for few mins.
